sources.entry: Docker Registry | Toolkit and server to store and distribute container images

summary.one_liner: Distribution is an open-source container registry implementation of the OCI Distribution Specification, plus Go libraries for building registry tooling.
summary.what_it_does: The repository's main product is the Open Source Registry for storing and distributing container images and other content via the OCI Distribution Specification. It is described as a base for large-scale registry solutions or a simple private registry. The repo contains the registry component, a set of libraries for interacting with distribution components (documented via godoc), and full documentation hosted externally. Clients such as Docker communicate with it over HTTP. The README notes that the bundled client implementation is used by Docker but is deprecated in favor of the containerd implementation and will not get new features. The README also states the project aims to provide a secure toolchain for distributing content.
use_cases: host registry content for Docker or other OCI clients
embed registry libraries in Go tooling
notable: Reference implementation of the OCI Distribution Specification
Core library used by Docker Hub, GitHub Container Registry, GitLab Container Registry, and Harbor, per the README
Includes reusable Go libraries alongside the registry server
Client code is deprecated in favor of containerd
caveats: Libraries' interfaces are unstable, per the README
Bundled Docker client is deprecated and will not support new features
README does not include install or run instructions; full docs are external
